_comment: The performance invariant, in numbers. scripts/gate.sh enforces every figure and refuses the deploy on any breach. Baselines recorded 2026-08-02; raise a budget only as a deliberate reviewed decision, never to make a red gate green.

play_latency._comment: Press play to the dock clock leaving 0:00 — real decoded audio, quantized +~1000ms by the clock display. Baselines 2026-08-02: 1378 ms unthrottled (~350 real), 5537 ms through the 5 Mbit pacing proxy. The throttled figure is a RELATIVE regression index, not a fidelity claim — per-connection TCP pacing is harsher than a real 5 Mbit link (where play starts in ~1 s). Both budgets trip on regression from today's truth. Known follow-up: the audio element fetches the whole file eagerly (preload=auto); tuning that is an investigation, not a budget adjustment.

payload._comment: Decoded JS bytes the library page actually loads, measured in-browser by the gate — cache-independent and immune to Next's manifest reshuffles. Baseline 640 KB on 2026-08-02 after splitting the video-extract stack into a lazy chunk; the budget is tight on purpose — raising it is a reviewed decision, and heavy features belong behind dynamic imports.

live_smoke._comment: Against cr8.li after deploy, from the LAN. Generous because Cloudflare is in the path; these catch a broken origin, not micro-regressions.
